mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_ai_assistant_policy (id, enabled_tools, allowed_tool_names, proposals_enabled, max_tool_calls_per_run, safety_mode, network_mode, context_message_limit, summary_max_chars, max_run_seconds, version, create_time, create_by, edit_time, edit_by) VALUES (#{id}, #{enabledTools}, #{allowedToolNames}, #{proposalsEnabled}, #{maxToolCallsPerRun}, #{safetyMode}, #{networkMode}, #{contextMessageLimit}, #{summaryMaxChars}, #{maxRunSeconds}, #{version}, #{createTime}, #{createBy}, #{editTime}, #{editBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE t_ai_assistant_policy SET enabled_tools = #{policy.enabledTools}, allowed_tool_names = #{policy.allowedToolNames}, proposals_enabled = #{policy.proposalsEnabled}, max_tool_calls_per_run = #{policy.maxToolCallsPerRun}, safety_mode = #{policy.safetyMode}, network_mode = #{policy.networkMode}, context_message_limit = #{policy.contextMessageLimit}, summary_max_chars = #{policy.summaryMaxChars}, max_run_seconds = #{policy.maxRunSeconds}, version = version + 1, edit_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, edit_by = #{policy.editBy} WHERE id = 1 AND version = #{expectedVersion}
